item.title: Iran’s new defense minister: Heavy fighter jet built domestically expected to take flight next year
item.description:
Iran’s new Defense Minister, Mehrdad Ahlaghki Ketabchi, announced that Iran is making progress in developing an indigenously produced heavy fighter jet, expressing hope that the aircraft will make its maiden flight in 2027.
According to the minister, the aircraft’s initial testing phases are scheduled to take place later this year. The announcement comes as Iran pursues plans to develop independent capabilities to manufacture heavy, multirole fighter jets.

item.title: Stolen car driver tries to ram police vehicle near Tekoa, arrested after officers shoot at tires
item.description:
A police chase involving a vehicle stolen from Jerusalem ended with the arrest of a suspect near Tekoa after he reportedly endangered officers and attempted to ram a police vehicle. During the pursuit, officers fired at the vehicle’s tires in an attempt to stop it.
After the vehicle came to a halt, the suspect attempted to flee on foot toward nearby orchards. Officers continued pursuing him and managed to apprehend him.

item.title: President Isaac Herzog to depart for a diplomatic visit to Budapest
item.description:
On October 20, President Isaac Herzog will depart for a 12-hour visit to Budapest, Hungary. During the visit, President Herzog will be received at the Sándor Palace by President András Baka of Hungary. The two presidents will hold a diplomatic meeting to discuss deepening cooperation and strengthening relations between the two countries. President Herzog will then meet with the Prime Minister of Hungary, Péter Magyar, for a diplomatic meeting on advancing bilateral cooperation between the two countries.
At the center of the visit will be President Herzog’s address to the international Voice of the People conference. The conference is part of a global initiative established by President Herzog that brings together Jewish leaders and young people from the Diaspora and from Israel, with the aim of strengthening ties and advancing a shared dialogue on the challenges facing the Jewish people. President Herzog will conclude the visit with a meeting with the leaders of Hungary’s Jewish community.

item.title: Report: Lebanon informed US of willingness to participate in military talks with Israel in Florida
item.description:
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has informed US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that his country is ready to participate in a military meeting with Israel, a source familiar with the details told the Asharq Al-Awsat newspaper.
According to the report, Beirut hopes that the meeting will lead to a commitment from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to a ceasefire, and to expanding the activity of the "verification mechanism" for the purpose of deploying the Lebanese army in the "pilot area." Aoun announced yesterday that the next round of talks between Israel and Lebanon will take place on October 20 in Tampa, Florida. According to him, Lebanon will send a military delegation to the meeting to present its demand that Israel stop the escalation in Lebanese territory.

item.title: Lindsey Graham's sister against Trump: I don't trust Putin and Russia
item.description:
About two and a half weeks before the midterm elections in the United States, Senator Darlene Graham Nordon, sister of the late Senator Lindsey Graham, criticized President Donald Trump's decision to exempt Russia from the new sanctions imposed by the law bearing her brother's name.
"Personally, I would choose to put pressure on Russia to end the war and lower gas prices. I don't trust Putin, and I don't trust Russia," she said.
